author: Skquid
body:
Alright, so, I was playing On one of the servers (Pretty sure it was mix) and after one of the matches, I realized my Xp was reset. Originally, I thought I had prestiged, but there was no way, I was only level 12. I checked the forums, and try profile says that I have the 3,000 xp that I had, but the in game bar said that I was level 0 with only 56 xp.... Help?






Edit: after a few hours, the levels showed up again, on all servers. This is no doubt a glitch.
